Bash(F:/A-War-Without-Victory/tools/_fix_enclave.py << 'PYEOF'
import json

FILE = "F:/A-War-Without-Victory/data/source/oob_brigades.json"

with open\(FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8"\) as f:
    data = json.load\(f\)

fixed = 0
for b in data["brigades"]:
    sub = b.get\("subordinate_to", ""\)
    if b["faction"] == "RBiH" and \("28th_independent" in sub or "81st_independent" in sub\):
        if b.get\("available_from"\) != 12:
            print\(f"  Fixing {b['id']}: available_from {b.get\('available_from'\)} -> 12"\)
            b["available_from"] = 12
            # These should NOT be mandatory \(not turn 0\)
            if "mandatory" in b:
                del b["mandatory"]
            fixed += 1

print\(f"\\nFixed {fixed} enclave brigades"\)

with open\(FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8"\) as f:
    json.dump\(data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False\)
    f.write\("\\n"\)

print\("Done"\)
PYEOF)

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat\(map_hoi\): fix ortho zoom — frustum scales with scroll wheel

The ortho camera frustum was fixed at ±4 regardless of zoom level.
In orthographic projection, moving the camera closer/further has no
visible effect — only frustum size matters. Now zoom controls frustum
half-height \(0.3–10 range\), updateCamera\(\) centralizes all frustum
and position recalculation, and pan speed scales with zoom level.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat\(map_hoi\): auto-load latest save on startup, add Load Save file picker

In standalone browser mode \(no Electron IPC bridge\), the map now
auto-loads data/derived/latest_run_final_save.json on startup.
A "Load Save" button in the top bar opens a file picker for loading
any save JSON. Top bar, sidebar, and status strip all populate from
the loaded game state.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat\(map_hoi\): political control fills + settlement borders render over terrain

Fix control polygon visibility by addressing z-fighting between terrain mesh
and transparent control overlays: terrain gets polygonOffset, control meshes
get depthWrite:false + renderOrder layering + DoubleSide + Y offset 0.01.
Settlement border LineSegments render at Y+0.015, renderOrder 2.

Race condition fix: auto-load save fetch can complete before renderer.init\(\)
finishes, so pendingData pattern stores control/edges for deferred application.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
